title: $240 Million Cattle Scheme. FBI Fugitive Caught at LAX.

lines.say: Guilty. Joshua Link's cattle company collected over two hundred forty million dollars. Then he landed on the FBI's wanted list.
lines.show: Guilty. Joshua Link's cattle company collected over $240 million. Then he landed on the FBI's wanted list.

lines.say: The FBI's poster said Agridime purchased only a fraction of the cattle.
lines.show: The FBI's poster said "Agridime purchased only a fraction of the cattle."

scene.src: FBI wanted poster, Joshua Robert Link (2026)

lines.say: On March ninth, he was taken into custody at Los Angeles International Airport.
lines.show: On March 9, he was taken into custody at Los Angeles International Airport.

lines.say: On November tenth, a Fort Worth jury convicted him and his brother Jason. Sentencing is set for March.
lines.show: On November 10, a Fort Worth jury convicted him and his brother Jason. Sentencing is set for March.

lines.say: How many years should he get? Tell me below.
